授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 自然科学分野では，観察や実験に基づいた理論構築やモデル化を行う事で，自然界の複雑な現象を理解し，様々な事に応用する．このうち物理現象の幾つかは身近な日常生活で直接的に経験できる．ここでは，物理学における基礎的な現象や法則を理解し，それらを数学的な表現で捉える能力を養う．具体的には，微分や積分の本質的理解，ベクトルや複素数の応用を通じて，物理学の基礎知識を習得する．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Understanding complicated phenomena in the natural world and applying the natural sciences to various aspects is achieved by theoretical constructs based on evidence, and modeling through observation and experimentation. Some of the physical phenomena can be directly experienced in daily life. In this class, it is aimed to comprehend fundamental principles and phenomena in physics and develop the ability to understand them through mathematical representations. Specifically, through a fundamental understanding of differentiation, integration, and the application of vectors and complex numbers, foundational knowledge in physics are acquired.
